subject: general
question: Parshavnatha temple is located in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Parshavnatha temple:**

 
 
• It is a** Jain temple** dedicated to **Parshvanatha,** the **23rd Tirthankara** in **Jainism.**
 
• The temple is located in the city of** Nakoda** in the** Barmer** district of **Rajasthan.**
 
• The temple is also known as Nakoda Jain temple or **Shri Nakoda Parshvanath Jain Tirth.**
 
• The temple is considered to be one of the most** important Jain pilgrimage sites** in India, attracting thousands of devotees every year.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**List of few other Jain temples:**

 
• Ranakpur Jain Temple, Ranakpur (Rajasthan)
 
• Gomateshwara Temple, Vindhyagiri Hill (Karnataka)
 
• Dilwara Temple, Mount Abu (Rajasthan) 
 
• Sri Digambar Jain Lal Mandir, Chandni Chowk (Delhi)
 
• Palitana Temples, Bhavnagar District (Gujarat)
 
• Sonagiri Temples, Datia (Madhya Pradesh)
